verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform within a broader HR and payroll suite, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no mention of any CLI. The llms.txt probe and the failed OpenAPI probes do not show a command-line tool, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
